name: c2_frozen
folds: outer fold k: test=k, inner validation=(k+1)%5, train=other three
training_beats: scored (t>=60 s), label in {0 negative, 1 positive}; excluded-label beats never trained on
scored_set_for_all_methods: t>=60 s and R1 history available (>=30 eligible beats in previous 10 min)
input: int8 window of 75 samples, float input = int8/16
architecture: beatnet-tiny Appendix A: conv1 1->8 k7 s1; conv2 8->16 k5 s2; conv3 16->16 k3 s2; GAP mean (float) / sum (int); fc 16->2; ReLU; no batch-norm; TF-style same padding (see py/edge_nets.py)
loss: cross-entropy on 2 logits; score = logit1 - logit0
epoch_sampling: all positives + equal number of negatives drawn at random without replacement each epoch (1:1)
device: CPU, 1 torch thread per process, one process per (fold, seed)
R0: score=|ST level| (R+100..120 ms vs baseline R-18..R-11 samples); clinical-style point |ST|>=100 uV also reported
R1: score=|ST level - median ST level of previous 600 s of eligible beats|, needs >=30 beats history
operating_point: threshold = score value giving 1% false-positive rate on inner-validation negatives (np.quantile(neg, 0.99)); applied unchanged to the test fold; alert if score > threshold
curve_summary: sensitivity read from the test-fold ROC at 1% FPR (threshold = 99th percentile of the test fold's own negatives) used only for method-to-method comparison

persistence.alert: rising edge of the condition over eligible beats; first 60 s ignored

episode_rules.caught: an alert between episode onset and end
episode_rules.lead_sign: lead = onset - alert time (min); positive = before onset
episode_rules.false_alert: alert outside every ST/T episode +-30 min; rate = count / episode-free elapsed hours * 24

bootstrap.pooling: per-fold thresholds from the (resampled) fold negatives, TP/FN pooled over 5 folds; M2 statistic = mean over 3 seeds

pass_rule_1: lower end of 95% bootstrap range of (M2 sens@1%FPR - better of R0,R1 sens@1%FPR) > 0, better rule identified by point estimate
leakage_demo: seed 0, random beat-wise split with the same number of train / validation / test beats as fold 0 (test=fold0 size, val=fold1 size, train=folds 2-4 size)
shift_note: the >>8 input shift is the brief default; not changed
